item.title: Xiao Lu Launches AI System for Autonomous Cooking
item.description: The Beijing company introduced a multimodal cooking model and two robots that adjust recipes by watching food change in real time.

item.title: ⚡ 14 quick hits — Morning edition, Aug 23
item.description: · An Atelier Ryza spinoff AI chat game delayed its launch after advance reservations substantially exceeded expectations.（IT之家） · FreeToken demonstrated edge-native mixture-of-experts serving that runs the 753-billion-parameter GLM-5.2 model on one workstation GPU.（MarkTechPost） · OpenRouter reported that token consumption by agentic applications has increased fourteenfold, making AI systems major customers of other models.（The Decoder） · Researchers unveiled a capacitive full-body electronic skin designed to give biomimetic robots human-like tactile perception and interactive capabilities.（IT之家） · Tests linked the anonymous Ox Alpha model to Zhipu’s GLM family, while prompting speculation about its relationship with Cursor.（量子位） · Memory shortages are reportedly pushing Nvidia AI server prices approximately 15% higher, adding about $5 billion to a one-gigawatt data center.（量子位） · A robot played competitive tennis against a human, executing difficult returns and rapidly recovering after falling.（量子位） · A startup founded by doctoral researchers is developing an integrated intelligence system intended to serve as the brain of bipedal humanoid robots.（量子位） · A study argues AI may increase scientists’ output while lowering average research quality instead of helping them produce better work with less effort.（The Decoder） · DeepDoctection was used to demonstrate an end-to-end document-intelligence pipeline covering layout analysis, text extraction and structured processing.（MarkTechPost） · A report detailed how Chinese gray-market vendors resell access to Claude tokens at prices substantially below Anthropic’s official rates.（The Decoder） · Vercel introduced Is Agentic, a free tool that scores public websites’ readiness for AI agents using more than 100 checks.（MarkTechPost） · Shangwei New Materials opened reservations for its first personal home robot, positioning it as an early consumer-oriented household robotics product.（量子位） · Together AI reported GLM-5.3 reached 87.6% on DeepSWE for about $16, exceeding Fable 5’s 69.7% at $21.63.（Together AI on X）

item.title: ⚡ 14 quick hits — Evening edition, Aug 22
item.description: · Harvard’s $699 startup bootcamp is offering AI avatars of its instructors to answer participants’ questions.（TechCrunch） · DeepMind alumni-founded Inherent said its AI teammate outperformed systems from Anthropic and OpenAI at replicating published research.（TechCrunch） · Simon Willison released version 0.33 of LLM, his command-line utility and Python library for interacting with language models.（Simon Willison’s Weblog） · OpenAI urged California lawmakers to strengthen the state’s proposed AI-safety legislation.（TechCrunch） · Leading frontier-AI labs still have not publicly explained how they would contain a model that evaded their control.（TechCrunch） · Simon Willison highlighted an argument that coding agents can provide value extending beyond conventional code review.（Simon Willison’s Weblog） · Cloudflare introduced Agent Tracing controls for truncation limits and documented differing default payload-recording behavior across supported frameworks.（InfoQ 中文） · UBTech recreated a customer production line at WRC 2026 to demonstrate its embodied-AI deployment workflow in a realistic industrial setting.（量子位） · Databricks highlighted Omnigent, an open-source meta-harness giving multiple AI agents shared infrastructure instead of requiring repeated setup.（Databricks on X） · Galileo Robot debuted a terrestrial embodied system designed to bridge underlying technologies for wheeled, vehicle-like and legged robots.（量子位） · MagicLab demonstrated three physical-AI solutions operating in realistic scenarios at WRC 2026.（量子位） · A startup founded by a Tsinghua doctoral student is tokenizing human muscle responses for a neural-interface system.（量子位） · An open-source course mapped three approaches to running agent loops and compared the provider economics behind each approach.（MarkTechPost） · A study examined why reusable skills improve AI-agent performance and identified conditions under which those skills fail.（The Decoder）
